answers.q1: pnpm (pnpm@12.10.0 per the packageManager field; the preinstall script enforces it with only-allow, and Node must be ^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0). Install with: pnpm install
answers.q2: pnpm run build && pnpm test. CI builds first. `pnpm test` runs `pnpm test:unit && pnpm test-serve && pnpm test-build`. CI also runs `pnpm run test-serve-bundled`, which `pnpm test` doesn't include. The e2e tests need the Playwright browser: pnpm playwright install chromium
answers.q4: pnpm run build && pnpm run lint:js && pnpm format && git diff --exit-code && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test-docs. These are the CI lint job's steps. `pnpm format` runs oxfmt, and `git diff --exit-code` fails if it changed any files. The build comes first, as in CI. I couldn't confirm that `git diff` works here, since this directory isn't a git repository.
answers.q5: I found no vendored directories. Generated or build output that shouldn't be edited by hand: `**/dist/` in each package (including packages/vite/dist), `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` (generated at release; oxfmt ignores it), and `playground-temp/` (a test copy of playground). The `**/temp/` directories and `docs/.vitepress/cache/` are also ignored by ESLint. Fixtures and snapshots are test data, so only change them deliberately: `**/fixtures/**` and `**/*.snap` (ESLint ignores both).
